name: smithers
description: Drive Smithers, the durable control plane for long-running coding agents: plan, approve, run, watch, and resume durable flows.

interface.shortDescription: Durable, resumable AI flows you drive from the terminal
interface.longDescription: Smithers is a durable control plane for long-running coding agents. This plugin lets Codex plan a flow, clear its approval gate, run it, watch it to completion, and resume it after a crash, so multi-step work survives a lost session instead of restarting from the beginning.
defaultPrompt: List the Smithers flows available in this repo.
Plan a Smithers flow that implements this and reviews it, then run it so I can watch.
